body: Q164 Part 2: the mechanism is NOT a realtime scale inflation (disproved - RT margins are 0.7x AT). The fix is the boxing profile in combat_rulesets.json: margin_wide 6->15, ten_eight_requires_damage=true, ten_eight_damage_bar=25. The damage gate was the existing mechanism; it just was not enabled for boxing. Owned files: combat_rulesets.json, judge_panel_test.gd (T5+re-pins), q164_round_margins.gd (tool), Q164_DIGEST.md. Did NOT edit FightRealtime.gd, JudgePanel.gd, or GameState.gd.
